text: Re: Miles v. Philip Morris Companies, Inc.
Please be advised that, in response to a request made by George Zelcs, Philip Morris is
making the documents identified on the attached list available to Mr. Zelcs at the deposition
of Ms. LeVan on September 5, 2001. All the documents are "Highly Confidential" and
must be handled and maintained strictly in accordance with the provisions applicable to
such documents in the Protective Order entered by the Court.
Philip Morris counsel will retain all the documents after the deposition. If you wish to have
any of the documents produced, please contact Arthur Newbold or Christopher Michie.
